    • Constructor Detail

      • MainMenu

        public MainMenu(int windowWidth,
                int windowHeight,
                Pong pong)
        Builds the overlay for the labels. The panel covers the whole playing field but is transparent, acts only as a frame for other labels.
        Parameters:
        windowWidth - the width of the game in pixels
        windowHeight - the height of the game in pixels
